items.information: **🇧🇷 Português:** A competição é aberta a participantes de todas as idades. As inscrições devem ser realizadas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, mediante pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição será confirmada apenas após a validação do pagamento. Para garantir o bom andamento do evento, ao se inscrever em uma modalidade você também assume o compromisso de atuar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria, conforme estabelecido pelas regras da WCA. Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, com as responsabilidades divididas entre todos os competidores. Em cada modalidade haverá, no mínimo, dois grupos: em um deles você competirá e, no outro, ajudará como juiz ou embaralhador. Ao efetuar sua inscrição, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizarem gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e filmagens realizadas durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- **🇺🇸 English:** The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registrations must be made exclusively through the WCA website, with the entry fee paid in advance via PIX. Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation. To ensure the smooth running of the event, by registering for an event you also commit to serving as a judge or scrambler in that category, as established by the WCA regulations. In this way, the competition becomes self-sustainable, with responsibilities shared among all competitors. For each event, there will be at least two groups: in one you will compete, and in the other you will serve as a judge or scrambler. By completing your registration, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to freely use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, including for commercial purposes.

The competition features Clock as the main event, alongside other official events: 3x3, 2x2, 6x6, Skewb, 3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4 Blindfolded, and Fewest Moves (FMC). The competition will also include several unofficial events: 3×3 Supersolve, Master Magic, Cap On Pen, and the Mystery Event (limited to 6 participants). Participation in these events is completely optional—please visit the Unofficial Events tab for full details, rules, and registration instructions. We encourage all competitors and guests to carefully read through the information tabs to stay updated on the schedule, event rules, venue guidelines, and registration requirements. This will help ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience for everyone.

items.information: **Blindfolded Events Only** The only events held at this competition are blindfolded events, which require a significant amount of concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to remain AS QUIET AS POSSIBLE throughout the day to allow competitors to concentrate. **Note for New Competitors** Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they can solve puzzles blindfolded, this competition is not the traditional WCA competition experience. Please consider registering for another competition, such as [UMBC Winter 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UMBCWinter2026), if this one isn't for you.
